title: English in a Minute: Dish It Out but Can't Take It
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/8009981.html

sentences.text: Welcome to English in a Minute.
When we dish out food, we put it on a plate to give to others.
But what does dish it out but can't take it mean?
Okay, she joked about your piano playing.
So I joked about her singing.
And she got angry at me.
Oh, so she can dish it out, but she can't take it.
Some people insult, joke about, or criticize others.
But they don't like it when people do the same to them.
So we say, they can dish it out, but they can't take it.
